g.title: MinVelRank1Convo3 begins.
g.text: MinVelRank1Convo3 begins.

g.title: j1443093862
g.text: MomToxicated: Drifter. Can we talk?

g.title: j2608962349
g.text: G'morning, Minerva. If that is your real name.

g.title: j1108964078
g.text: We've dropped the "quotes", I see.

g.title: j637640821
g.text: Now you're asking?

g.title: j1930371320
g.text: Yeah?

g.title: j265431232
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2258223472
g.text: MomToxicated: I was lectured about my so-called bedside manner.

g.title: j1644294953
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3991922425
g.text: MomToxicated: Believe it or not, it is.

g.title: j3650488538
g.text: MomToxicated: Which is hysterical, all things considered.

g.title: j4135116944
g.text: MomToxicated: Right to the chase. Good.

g.title: j935222474
g.text: MomToxicated: But that's not the point.

g.title: j1762006996
g.text: MomToxicated: We're here in Höllvania with a problem to solve. And you can help me solve that problem.

g.title: j2862732985
g.text: MomToxicated: So I need you - and this is me asking - to help me.

g.title: j3997286208
g.text: What is the problem I'm supposed to be solving?

g.title: j4084232984
g.text: Why should I help you?

g.title: j4179255953
g.text: And what does this have to do with Rusalka?

g.title: j2868266998
g.text: MomToxicated: That is a very good question.

g.title: j4136039149
g.text: MomToxicated: You don't have to want to help me for my sake. We have a common enemy. This "Man in the Wall."

g.title: j1126466904
g.text: MomToxicated: As far as I can figure, we're both interested in where he's gone, what he's after, and why he targeted Rusalka in the first place.

g.title: j1592221077
g.text: MomToxicated: Am I correct in that assessment?

g.title: j1244469894
g.text: Can you back up and take a minute to explain to me why you care about Rusalka so much?

g.title: j2647610061
g.text: For the first two, yeah. I don't actually really care two shits about why he went after Rusalka.

g.title: j2056759131
g.text: Sure. Yeah. That's correct.

g.title: j573259736
g.text: MomToxicated: The why isn't important.

g.title: j787185143
g.text: MomToxicated: If you aren't at least mildly interested in her well-being, why spare her life like we know you did? We heard the story.

g.title: j4116038899
g.text: I hate to break it to you, but we're probably stuck waiting until the Man in the Wall makes his next move.

g.title: j1092760199
g.text: PapaPolar: it is, though. and they've probably worked it out already, anyway. it's not like we're exactly subtle

g.title: j2410257606
g.text: Because then I'd have been no different than the Indifference. Than Scaldra. Than Entrati. I don't go around senselessly murdering people.

g.title: j4085616820
g.text: Because it wasn't really her making the choices that led her to that point. Just because I wouldn't kill her for it in the moment, doesn't mean I *care* enough to go out of my way to save her.

g.title: j3515431791
g.text: Because I wasn't about to do Entrati's dirty work for him. If he wanted to kill the Indifference's new puppet, he could do it himself.

g.title: j2590003669
g.text: MomToxicated: And why is that? You have no way of tracking him? It? Whatever it is? Or do you not know what it's really after?

g.title: j326849050
g.text: PapaPolar: and maybe, *just maybe* if you trusted our new lil buddy here with a little bit of information, they might be more willing to *heeeeelp uuuuuus*

g.title: j634874136
g.text: Which implies that I purposefully murder people. Which I don't. I mean. I do kill people. But it's different. You know what I mean.

g.title: j3951379023
g.text: I didn't *know* her.

g.title: j2710541999
g.text: But just as I suspected, the old bastard only likes to shoot people he knows will get back up.

g.title: j3511476508
g.text: Can't exactly slap a tracking beacon on a demigod-god-thing, no.

g.title: j178985928
g.text: His motivations are a bit lost on us at the moment, yeah. But it's nothing good.

g.title: j3685051437
g.text: PapaPolar: it's almost like that's how people work sometimes.

g.title: j2855495730
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2553761133
g.text: PapaPolar: and we're not exactly giving you a reason to care. are we, M?

g.title: j2364946716
g.text: PapaPolar: a very oddly specific statement but okay

g.title: j3554273805
g.text: MomToxicated: So you're suggesting we sit. And wait. For it to... what. Pop its head up? And we play a round of Whack-A-Weasel?!

g.title: j1018126621
g.text: MomToxicated: What good would it do?

g.title: j1791981683
g.text: PapaPolar: you're talking to a pair of ex-military special ops, we get it. lol

g.title: j944260778
g.text: MomToxicated: Shut it, Velimir.

g.title: j3302977596
g.text: It's fine. I die a lot. I'm used to it.

g.title: j2729552440
g.text: It doesn't really matter.

g.title: j2737920194
g.text: PapaPolar: at least this place has good company and a nice bar?

g.title: j3800587535
g.text: PapaPolar: doesn't hurt to have friends in this world, M.

g.title: j3680620185
g.text: PapaPolar: what we have to do in the name of the "greater good" gets blurry sometimes

g.title: j17356323
g.text: PapaPolar: oookie dokie... sure, lil buddy... sure...

g.title: j2398930226
g.text: Why are you so desperate to learn what happened to Rusalka?

g.title: j4257678708
g.text: PapaPolar: music is pretty good. that arthur guy seems like my kinda drinking buddy

g.title: j4074619233
g.text: MomToxicated: What do we need "friends" for?! We'll be out of here as soon as we know where we need to be to save Neci.

g.title: j2381215934
g.text: PapaPolar: which is why, when we can do something that matters, we do it. which is why we're here trying to save neci

g.title: j1689203810
g.text: PapaPolar: anyway...

g.title: j3407634611
g.text: MomToxicated: And, what, we just go on with not knowing what's really happened to her?! Or if she's okay?! Or if she's really her anymore?!

g.title: j2940485056
g.text: PapaPolar: dunno about that. seems like it's gonna be hard to predict the movements of a demigod void monster... thingy. amirite, lil buddy?

g.title: j1442961474
g.text: MomToxicated: How can you sit there and be OKAY with that, Velimir?!

g.title: j503904885
g.text: PapaPolar: i never said i was okay with it, M! i just understand when we have to sit and bide our time!

g.title: j3804052371
g.text: MomToxicated: I've talked to Eleanor. She told me what she felt when she touched Neci's mind. Or what was left of it.

g.title: j2768733132
g.text: MomToxicated: The woman we raised. The woman we loved as our own.

g.title: j338254703
g.text: MomToxicated: Who knows what -

g.title: j3122582776
g.text: MomToxicated: And you want to talk about drinking with Arthur.

g.title: j794567701
g.text: MomToxicated: Du-te dracu, Velimir.

g.title: j527925381
g.text: PapaPolar: aaaaaand she's off...

g.title: j2560379249
g.text: What'd she say...?

g.title: j2094099037
g.text: Gonna guess that was rude language.

g.title: j2259730985
g.text: PapaPolar: joy of having been stationed on so many overseas ops. getting cussed out in 100 different languages

g.title: j983890413
g.text: PapaPolar: yeah. joy of having been stationed on so many overseas ops. getting cussed out in 100 different languages

g.title: j3284780661
g.text: Are you two... married?

g.title: j834045179
g.text: You two... raised... Rusalka?

g.title: j1269960735
g.text: Boolean MinervaVelimir1 is now true.

g.title: j1737270665
g.text: Boolean MinervaNeci3a is now true.

g.title: j1269985799
g.text: PapaPolar: mmm. kinda. not really anymore. on paper only. somewhere. in some country that stopped existing circa 1982?

g.title: j2561585740
g.text: PapaPolar: more or less. we were overseas in a lil town a few countries south of here. place got blown to bits. found her there in a building, all red hair and aaaaaangry.

g.title: j3428870577
g.text: PapaPolar: does that count?

g.title: j4149278766
g.text: PapaPolar: she tried to stab me six times with a spoon bahahaha cutest lil thing you've ever seen.

g.title: j2376939061
g.text: Yeah, doesn't seem like you two are still together.

g.title: j890907450
g.text: That explains the arguing I guess.

g.title: j686305401
g.text: PapaPolar: had this little stuffed rabbit toy she was clinging to, though. M told her she'd protect it with her life 'n keep it safe.

g.title: j576741835
g.text: PapaPolar: what gave it away.

g.title: j2983703078
g.text: PapaPolar: when neci left to go join scaldra... things weren't ever the same between us. it was the last straw, i think.

g.title: j1948684473
g.text: PapaPolar: that got neci's trust real fast. ran right for M and threw her arms around her. we quit the military then. well. officially. became "consultants."

g.title: j2459821256
g.text: PapaPolar: sigh.

g.title: j2220832552
g.text: PapaPolar: so... yeah. you could say we raised her.

g.title: j90881465
g.text: PapaPolar: alright, gotta go do what i do best.

g.title: j719545298
g.text: PapaPolar: pretend i know what i said wrong and pretend i'll not screw up again like that in the future.

g.title: j2017522426
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank2Convo1.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank2Convo1.
